FAQ.subtitleHome: Quick answers before you get started

Home.a: Yes. Everything runs locally in your browser. Your files never leave your device and are not uploaded, stored, or shared.

Home.q: Do I need my Instagram password?
Home.a: No. You don’t need to log in or connect your account. You only use files that you download directly from Meta.

Home.q: Why do I need to download files from Meta?
Home.a: Instagram doesn’t provide this information directly. By using your exported data, we can accurately compare your followers and following lists.
About 5 minutes to request and download your data from Meta, and just a few seconds to process it here.

HowItWorks.q: What files do I need exactly?
HowItWorks.a: You need the followers and following files from your Meta account export. The step-by-step guide above shows exactly where to find them.
Your exported data includes complete lists of who you follow and who follows you. By comparing both lists locally, we can identify who doesn’t follow you back.

HowItWorks.q: What format should the files be in?
HowItWorks.a: The tool supports the default formats provided by Meta (usually JSON or HTML). Just download them as instructed in the guide.

HowItWorks.q: Can I use this on mobile?
HowItWorks.a: Yes, but using a desktop is recommended for a smoother experience when downloading and uploading files.

HowItWorks.q: Is any of my data sent to a server?
HowItWorks.a: No. All processing happens locally in your browser. Your data stays on your device at all times.

HowItWorks.q: Can you access my Instagram account?
HowItWorks.a: No. This tool has no access to your account. It only reads the files you manually provide.

HowItWorks.q: What if my files don’t work?
HowItWorks.a: Make sure you downloaded the correct files from Meta and didn’t modify them. If the issue persists, try downloading them again.

HowItWorks.q: Why not just use an app for this?
HowItWorks.a: Most apps require login access to your account. This tool avoids that completely by using your own exported data, making it safer and more private.
